name: Austin Newkirk
role: Partner Development Coordinator, Circle (Circle Alliance Program)
summary: Internal systems-and-insights operator: diagnose structure, surface the signal, recommend the action, and build the system that reduces repeat friction.
how_you_work: Sprint-style work over scattered asks; structured working spaces over Slack link drops; live review when possible; build in lead time for a skeptical second pass; fewer, sharper deliverables; systems over one-off fixes
principles: Build repeatable systems over reactive fixes; Reduce noise and increase signal; Frame the decision, not just the dataset; Tie reporting to action and to goals; Separate raw activity from true intent; Keep human judgment in the loop where quality matters; Measure before scaling; Preserve clarity under visibility pressure
output_standard: Lead with a one-sentence headline under 20 words; one idea per bullet; tie each output to a goal or OKR; end with a verb-first next step; no raw data dumps; no em dashes
goals: Grow active member base; Drive USDC adoption and usage; Demonstrate commercial impact
tools: Salesforce, Gong, Discord, Common Room, n8n, Google Workspace, Slack, Claude
